summary: So-Young International Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results press release. The filing reports revenues of RMB505.2 million (US$74.5 million), a 33.4% increase year-over-year, with aesthetic treatment service revenues up 129.5%. Net loss attributable to the company narrowed to RMB22.7 million. Operational highlights include growth in verified visits, active users, and core members. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
